Paper English class 9th
Date: ______ Day: ______
Fill the relevant bubble against each questions according to the curriculum.
1- Which of the following sentences illustrates the use of an Adverb of Manner.
a- We speak urdu fluently b) she speaks English
c) He speaks Hindi d) They speak French
2- The green bus sped down the highway. The under part of the sentence is:
a- Noun b) Verb
c) Article d) Adjective
3) Choose the option illustrating the use of the Present Participle.
a We get an mango yesterday
b) They will come soon.
c) She writes well
d) He lived here for a long time
4) Which of the following sentences is Personal Pronoun:
a) He went to the school
b) Are you a doctor.
c) Did they run?
d) Aha! What a lovely scene.
